<s>[INST] I want to know about the product Lactose Free Milk 0.5L [/INST] Product Type: Lactose Free Milk
Tag: No more bloating!
Category: Milk
What is it:
Lactose-free milk is prepared from Holstein Frisian cows' milk at our Someshwar, Baramati farm. The milk is automatically milked & then the Lactase enzyme is added to it, to make it easily digestible for the lactose intolerant. This milk comes with all the goodness of pure cow milk minus the lactose content.
Best for: People with lactose intolerance,Making lactose-free dairy preparations,Making great-tasting milkshakes,Tea & coffee
Not recommended for: People with dairy intolerance
